hypothesis: Cash and equivalents scaled by total assets measures balance-sheet liquidity and downside resilience. It is economically distinct from leverage, profitability, cash conversion and accrual factors: a firm can be profitable yet illiquid, and can be low-leverage while holding little cash. High cash intensity may indicate the ability to fund operations and investment without external financing during credit stress, and to survive demand shocks.

factor.formula: cash and cash equivalents divided by total assets; higher means a larger liquidity buffer
factor.point_in_time: statutory disclosure deadline plus three calendar days; provider announce dates are ignored because they are last-update timestamps and mixing them with statutory fallbacks makes effective dates non-monotonic; when two period ends share one effective date, the later period end wins
factor.missing_policy: no filling, no zero substitution, no fallback to debt ratio, ocf_ni, accrual or cash-flow stability factors
factor.effective_date: balance-sheet PIT effective date (announce date when valid, otherwise statutory deadline plus three calendar days)

universe.rule: historical HS300 members excluding industry_l1 in {银行, 非银金融}
universe.industry_source: current ext_hy_ths industry snapshot; not historical PIT

control_strategy.purpose: Same non-financial universe, cash-to-assets availability filter and execution; cash-to-assets is not scored.

execution.universe: historical non-financial HS300 membership; daily snapshots from 2022

samples.recent_12m: last 252 trading-day returns of the stitched 2022-2026 curve
samples.rolling_1y: 252-trading-day rolling compounded return over the stitched 2022-2026 curve

gates.D1: factor coverage within historical non-financial HS300 membership over 2022-2026 is at least 90%
gates.D2: first valid value occurs by 2022-06-30 and recent-12m coverage is at least 95%
gates.D3: mean absolute monthly cross-sectional Spearman correlation is at most 0.70 against both debt_ratio_latest and ocf_ni
gates.G1: discovery 2022-2024 total return is at least control + 5pp
gates.G2: discovery 2022-2024 MDD is no worse than control by more than 2pp
gates.G3: validation 2025-2026 total return is at least control - 5pp
gates.G4: full-sample rolling-1y positive rate is at least control
gates.G5: full-sample MDD is no worse than control by more than 2pp
gates.G6: full-sample total return is at least control - 5pp
gates.G7: recent 12m total return is positive and recent 12m MDD is no worse than control by more than 2pp
gates.G9: candidate full-sample total return is at least the R221 SG&A-level candidate full-sample total return minus 5pp

decision_rule: All D and G gates must pass. The factor definition, non-financial universe, scoring weights, holding period and stop loss are frozen before factor construction. No post-result relaxation, filling, industry redefinition, or substitution with prior factors is allowed.
known_limitations: The industry classification is a current snapshot, not a historical PIT industry series.
Financial tables are current snapshots; statutory deadlines are used because provider announcement dates are not reliable first-disclosure timestamps.
Cash intensity can reflect pre-announced capex or acquisitions rather than pure defensive strength; it is not a measure of cash quality or profitability.
Financial firms are excluded because cash and leverage definitions are not economically comparable.
The factor is research-only until every pre-registered gate passes.

revision_note.original_point_in_time: financial_pit_date (announce date when valid, otherwise statutory deadline plus three calendar days)
revision_note.reason: Mixing provider announce dates with statutory fallbacks produced non-monotonic effective dates: 25208 of 111313 balance-sheet rows had an effective date later than the next quarter's effective date, which would let an older annual report overwrite a newer quarterly report in join_asof.
revision_note.change: Use statutory disclosure deadline plus three calendar days, matching the R216/R218/R219/R229 builder family; on a shared effective date keep the later period end.
revision_note.scope: No gate, direction, weight, position count, holding period or stop-loss was changed.
